import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

def run(Bmax,Kd,K_ALB,Vp,CL,S0,mult,dur,tau,t0=0.5,T=6.,n=3001,f_b=0.0):
    def g(F):    return (1+K_ALB)+Bmax*Kd/(Kd+F)**2
    def elim(F): return CL*(F*(1+K_ALB)+f_b*Bmax*F/(Kd+F))
    F0 = S0/(CL*(1+K_ALB))          # analytic basal free (f_b = 0)
    def S(t):
        if t<t0: return S0
        if t<t0+dur: return S0*mult
        return S0*(1+(mult-1)*np.exp(-(t-t0-dur)/tau))
    ts=np.linspace(0,T,n)
    s=solve_ivp(lambda t,y:[(S(t)-elim(max(y[0],0)))/(Vp*g(max(y[0],0)))],
                (0,T),[F0],t_eval=ts,rtol=1e-8,atol=1e-10,max_step=0.02)
    return ts,s.y[0]

# ---- mouse corticosterone: Vp 1.5 mL, CBG capacity 500 nmol/L, weak albumin binding,
#      free CORT t1/2 ~7 min, 20-fold secretion rise for 15 min
MP=dict(Kd=30.,K_ALB=1.0,Vp=0.0015,CL=0.0178,mult=20.,dur=0.25,tau=0.25,T=6.)
S0=0.0178*5*2.0
tm,Fmw = run(Bmax=500.,S0=S0,**MP)
_ , Fmk = run(Bmax=0.  ,S0=S0,**MP)
print("=== mouse corticosterone, identical adrenal secretion ===")
print(f" basal free   WT {Fmw[0]:7.2f}  null {Fmk[0]:7.2f}  ratio {Fmk[0]/Fmw[0]:.3f}")
print(f" stress peak  WT {Fmw.max():7.2f}  null {Fmk.max():7.2f}  ratio {Fmk.max()/Fmw.max():.3f}")
print(f" free AUC     WT {np.trapz(Fmw,tm):7.2f}  null {np.trapz(Fmk,tm):7.2f}  "
      f"ratio {np.trapz(Fmk,tm)/np.trapz(Fmw,tm):.4f}")
mouse_occ={}
for KdR,lab in [(0.5,'MR'),(5.0,'GR')]:
    ow,ok=Fmw/(KdR+Fmw),Fmk/(KdR+Fmk)
    r=np.trapz(ok-ok[0],tm)/np.trapz(ow-ow[0],tm); mouse_occ[lab]=r
    print(f" {lab} stress occupancy-AUC ratio null/WT = {r:.3f}")

# ---- human run for the figure ----
HP=dict(Kd=30.,K_ALB=3.4,Vp=3.5,CL=25./4.4,mult=6.,dur=0.5,tau=0.33,T=6.)
S0h=(25./4.4)*10*4.4
ts,Fw = run(Bmax=700.,S0=S0h,**HP); _,Fk = run(Bmax=0.,S0=S0h,**HP)
occ={}
for KdR in [0.5,5.0,20.0,50.0]:
    ow,ok=Fw/(KdR+Fw),Fk/(KdR+Fk)
    occ[KdR]=np.trapz(ok-ok[0],ts)/np.trapz(ow-ow[0],ts)
print("\n=== human stress occupancy-AUC ratio null/normal (6 h window) ===")
for k,v in occ.items(): print(f"  receptor Kd {k:5.1f} nM : {v:.3f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.3))
x=(ts-0.5)*60
ax[0].plot(x,Fw,lw=2,color='#2b6cb0',label='CBG normal'); ax[0].plot(x,Fk,lw=2,color='#b2283c',label='CBG null')
ax[0].set_title('Human free cortisol\nequal 24 h area, different shape')
ax[0].set_ylabel('free cortisol (nmol/L)'); ax[0].set_xlabel('time from stress onset (min)')
ax[0].legend(frameon=False)
KdR=5.0
ax[1].plot(x,Fw/(KdR+Fw),lw=2,color='#2b6cb0',label='CBG normal')
ax[1].plot(x,Fk/(KdR+Fk),lw=2,color='#b2283c',label='CBG null')
ax[1].set_title('GR occupancy (Kd 5 nM)\nsaturation caps the taller null peak')
ax[1].set_ylabel('fractional occupancy'); ax[1].set_xlabel('time from stress onset (min)')
ax[1].legend(frameon=False)
labs=[f'Kd {k:g} nM' for k in occ]; vals=list(occ.values())
b=ax[2].bar(labs,vals,color=['#b2283c' if v<1 else '#2b6cb0' for v in vals])
ax[2].axhline(1,color='grey',ls='--',lw=1); ax[2].set_ylim(0,1.1)
ax[2].set_ylabel('stress occupancy-AUC, null / normal')
ax[2].set_title('Signal is lost in proportion to\nhow saturated the receptor already is')
for bb,v in zip(b,vals): ax[2].text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2,v+0.02,f'{v:.2f}',ha='center')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
